title: Create an saq prompt for my ap euro test on the enlightenment

messages.content: Create an saq prompt for my ap euro test on the enlightenment

**SAQ Prompt:**  
Identify two specific ideas of the Enlightenment that influenced political thought in eighteenth-century Europe, and explain how each idea contributed to changes in governance during this period.  

*(Sources: Britannica’s Enlightenment entries; Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy summary on Enlightenment politics.)*
